titlePlain: Choosing Storage — OLTP vs. OLAP vs. Object
subtitle: Lesson 4 · System Design for Data Engineers

code:
OLTP:            row-oriented, fast single-row reads/writes
OLAP:            column-oriented, fast aggregation across
                 millions of rows (Fabric Warehouse, KQL Database)
Object storage:  files in cheap, durable blob storage (OneLake)
caption: You've already used all three -- now recognize them as a choice.

code:
Vendor's live booking app:        OLTP (row-level updates)
Raw incoming trip files:          Object storage (Delta/Parquet)
Aggregated dashboards & reports:  OLAP (KQL Database/Warehouse)
caption: Not "which one" -- "which one, for which part."
